observations: Main1 explicitly states no notable biological activities reported for scandine itself; do not transfer activities of congeners.
Main5 note29 establishes asymmetric alkynylation was not the successful route; fixed SMILES stereochemistry is a representative of racemate, not enantiopure natural scandine.
Mechanistic ylide22, retrosynthetic structures and failed target13 excluded from experimentally obtained compounds.
